Tale of 1971 Indian war veterans
2016-12-15T22:46:07+06:00 | Zahed Khan
https://www.thedailystar.net/war-heroes-video-interviews/tale-1971-indian-war-veterans-1330429

They share the eternal bond of camaraderie having shed blood while fighting a common enemy . Taking about the Indian army who fought with us against Pakistan army and their companions in Liberation War 1971. A delegation of 28 Indian War Veterans and four serving officers arrived Dhaka on a five day visit on December 14, 2016. In this video they shared their stories of those days.
